rationale: Classify this exact second terminal operationally as isolated_runtime_failure after reviewing both events as a pattern. Two on-schedule acquisitions in the common sampler recorded GPU query TimeoutExpired and took 7.7129183 and 7.6020115 seconds. The unchanged monitor correctly stopped each attempt when valid completed observation coverage was unavailable. Both originals retain infrastructure invalidity, passed physics timing and post-run source-integrity checks, clean cleanup and complete model-call accounting. There is no observed source, readiness-identity, evaluator, oracle or evidence-integrity breach. Across all 132 original terminal records and 12257 repeated resource samples, only those two acquisitions showed this condition; the other 130 attempts had maximum capture duration 0.3155716 seconds. This supports intermittent, temporally bounded observation failures rather than a demonstrated continuously failed monitor or established systematic readiness defect. It does not establish random missingness, independence or nonrecurrence. The two incidents occur in the A3 conditions of C24-rep2; workload/architecture interaction remains unresolved and no causal persistence conclusion is drawn. The complete affected paired block remains excluded from primary analysis under the frozen rule, including all entrants and conditions. The prior C02-rep2 exclusion also remains. Separate 54-token and 8076-token synthetic model probes both completed 38 resource samples without a stall; they show contemporary responsiveness only, not full physical workload equivalence, repaired infrastructure or a replacement readiness gate. The native OS/driver cause and allocation among subprocess startup, communication, cleanup and scheduling remain unknown. The known unbounded Windows timeout-cleanup path is not proven to have caused these invalidities; shortening cleanup would still leave a missing GPU observation, so no speculative source repair is adopted. The contract permits an event-specific isolated operational classification without proof of root cause or nonrecurrence, while barring systematic or unknown-integrity problems. Root resolves the provisional hold through this scoped operational adjudication, not by treating clean probes as proof of repair. Continue only the untouched original manifests in stored order after immutable review recording and fresh runner validation. No episode is retried; no frozen source, policy, budget, threshold, readiness evidence, qualification or measured outcome changes. Any later uncovered invalidity stops execution and requires a fresh concrete pattern review; this decision gives no advance acceptance of future incidents.
